boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 39 is labeled 'Super Hard' and is the first triple-boss board in Block Out. The layout is a 2×2 grid: upper-left boss `14`, upper-right boss `21`, lower-right boss `4`, and a packed color mix in the lower-left. The `4` boss opens the lower half, the colored blocks drain next, then the `14` falls before the `21`. Every phase depends on the one before it, and the ordering is absolute.
landmarks: Block Out Level 39 is labeled 'Super Hard' and is the first triple-boss board in Block Out.
The layout is a 2×2 grid: upper-left boss `14`, upper-right boss `21`, lower-right boss `4`, and a packed color mix in the lower-left.
The `4` boss opens the lower half, the colored blocks drain next, then the `14` falls before the `21`.
Every phase depends on the one before it, and the ordering is absolute.

quickTips: Check the lower-right `4` counter before touching anything above it — if it is still alive, neither upper boss can move.
The cascade is strict: `4` → colors → `14` → `21`. No shortcuts.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Work the blocks around the lower-right `4` chamber first — shift adjacent colored blocks toward the bottom exits.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Thin the colored blocks in the lower-left quadrant (green, yellow, blue, red, purple) to create room for the `4` boss to collapse.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Once the `4` counter drops to zero (around 01:47), use the freed lower-right space to accelerate the color drain.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Start the upper-left `14` boss only after the lower half is mostly open — watch its counter drop through `10`.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Keep the upper-right `21` boss parked while the `14` is still falling.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Let the `21` boss begin its descent only after the `14` chamber has fully emptied and the upper roof is lighter.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last colored blocks and side counters after all three bosses are gone.

failurePoints: Splitting effort between all three bosses from the start — none reaches the critical threshold, and the board stalls because no single chamber gets enough room.
Attempting to reduce the `21` boss before the `14` has collapsed, which wastes the limited upper room on the larger counter.
